findings.detail: Legacy scorer evaluated records at the first scheduled run after a 24-hour minimum, not at one fixed horizon; it compared immutable emission references with mutable live CoinGecko prices and rewrote history and summary.

Current main publishes 45.5% (772/1,697) but the current-tree row-level history file is 0 bytes. The aggregate cannot be independently reproduced from current-tree row records and is not valid out-of-sample performance evidence.
Barrot's prompt and daily digest repeated the unvalidated percentage as predictive accuracy, allowing a misleading metric to feed back into system context.

An LLM sentiment classifier's bullish/neutral/bearish label and score were presented as BUY/SELL trading signals despite no target, horizon, point-in-time cutoff, source snapshot IDs, calibrated probability or independent outcome evaluation.

proposed_changes: Replace the mutable network scorer with a deterministic status-only compatibility entry point; do not access the network or modify history/summary.
Change the scheduled evaluation workflow to contents-read only and upload a bounded status artifact; no git push.
Preserve 45.5% and 772/1,697 in a clearly labeled unvalidated legacy archive.
Set public signal_accuracy.json to BLOCKED_NO_VALIDATED_FIXED_HORIZON_DATA and NOT_ISSUED.
Label sentiment output as a sentiment feature only, not a price forecast or trading instruction.
Remove legacy accuracy claims from Barrot system prompt and daily digest.
Make missing/nonfinite classifier confidence zero; do not invent a default probability.
Update landing/subscriber pages to remove unsupported BUY/SELL and predictive-performance claims.
Add fixed-horizon evaluation contract and no-network/no-write regression tests.
limitations: This proposal blocks the invalid scorer; it does not yet implement a validated fixed-horizon prediction model.
The emitted sentiment feature has no immutable source cutoff or source snapshot IDs and is explicitly forecast-ineligible.
No probability calibration, walk-forward performance, baseline comparison or drift result is claimed.
The legacy accuracy percentage remains preserved as unvalidated history, not deleted.
A future forecast pipeline needs point-in-time source snapshots, target/horizon contracts, independent outcome attestation and paper/shadow evaluation.
